text: {"memo": "CSCO FY2024 results show revenue of $53.80\u202fbillion, down from $57.00\u202fbillion in FY2023, reflecting a modest contraction. Net income fell to $10.32\u202fbillion versus $12.61\u202fbillion a year earlier, while operating income declined to $12.18\u202fbillion from $15.03\u202fbillion. Diluted EPS dropped to $2.54 from $3.07. Operating cash flow also weakened to $10.88\u202fbillion from $19.89\u202fbillion. Margins have compressed: FY2024 net margin of roughly 19% versus 22% in FY2023, and operating margin fell to about 23% from 26% a year ago. The decline in top\u2011line and cash generation suggests headwinds in the networking market, yet the company maintains a solid cash conversion and a strong balance sheet. The lower EPS and shrinking cash flow may pressure valuation multiples. Overall, the trend indicates a need for cost discipline and product innovation to reverse the downturn.\n\nView: Hold \u2013 earnings slowdown and margin pressure outweigh cash strength."}
